edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/mm/page_owner.c
+++ /linux/mm/page_owner.c
@@ -169,0 +170,8 @@
+
+	/*
+	 * On PREEMPT_RT, kmalloc() takes sleeping locks.
+	 * If we are in an atomic context (e.g. alloc_pages_nolock called
+	 * from atomic context), we cannot use kmalloc().
+	 */
+	if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_PREEMPT_RT) && in_atomic())
+		return;
